name: Fragments
storyline:
Delve into a hotel consumed by mystery
Fragments is a first-person horror, puzzle, and stealth game in which the player takes on the role of Eugène, an archivist hired to restore film reels at the LeBlanc Hotel.

There, he discovers film reels that, once assembled, allow him to follow Laura’s investigation. 20 years ago, she was investigating the disappearance of Eugène’s sister. With the help of a camera, he can reveal the hotel’s illusions that attempt to prevent him from following the clues left behind by Laura. He can also unlock doors to access places he should not be.

Haunted by the disappearance of his sister, Eugène decides to embark on this crazy exploration of the hotel and its past.

Uncover the mysteries of the hotel and escape the concierge as you try to understand what happened there. Where is Eugène’s sister, Sarah? Why is Mrs. LeBlanc, the hotel’s owner, investigating her guests? What secrets is Billy, the concierge, hiding?
summary: Explore the LeBlanc hotel and reveal hidden illusions through Eugene’s camera, an archivist. Follow in Laura’s footsteps, an investigator working on the disappearance of Eugene's sister, 20 years ago. Armed with a camera and discretion, can you discover the hotel’s heart and its mysteries?
